items.t: Cranks but won't start, often when hot
items.job: Replace PGM-FI main relay
items.note: Hours include basic no-start testing. If the distributor igniter or coil is the cause, parts cost more.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: A used transmission costs less. Honda's old warranty extension for these years has ended.

items.t: Airbag (SRS) light on from passenger seat sensor
items.job: Replace passenger seat-back occupant position sensor
items.note: Honda once extended coverage on this sensor; it has likely ended, but ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold (with built-in converter) and gaskets
items.note: Broken studs add time. The front catalytic converter is part of this manifold on many cars.

items.t: Head gasket leak and overheating
items.job: Replace head gasket and resurface cylinder head
items.note: Parts include gasket set, head bolts and machine shop work. Cost rises a lot if the engine was overheated badly.

items.t: Hybrid (IMA) battery weakening
items.job: Replace IMA hybrid battery pack
items.note: Hybrid battery; rebuilt or aftermarket packs cost less than a new Honda pack.

items.t: Cracked engine block coolant leak
items.job: Replace engine block (short block or complete engine)
items.note: Honda's 10-year block warranty extension has mostly ended. A used engine costs less.

items.t: Rapid or uneven rear tire wear
items.job: Replace rear upper control arms and align wheels
items.note: Hours include a four-wheel alignment. New rear tires are extra if the old ones are worn out.

items.t: Electric power steering feels heavy
items.job: Replace electric power steering rack
items.note: Sometimes only the steering control unit or torque sensor is replaced. Ask a dealer about past extended coverage.

items.t: Knock or clunk from torn engine mount
items.job: Replace right-side engine mount
items.note: Price is for one mount. Other mounts are often worn too.

items.t: CVT drive pulley damage (recall)
items.job: Update CVT software (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda's recall. Check your VIN. If the pulley is already damaged, the CVT may need replacing.

items.t: Fuel in the engine oil (oil dilution)
items.job: Update engine software and change oil
items.note: Honda covered the software update and extended warranty in cold-weather states. Ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: A/C stops blowing cold (condenser leak)
items.job: Replace A/C condenser and recharge refrigerant
items.note: Ask a Honda dealer whether goodwill or extended coverage applies to your VIN.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda's fuel pump recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Sticky or heavy steering (recall)
items.job: Inspect steering gearbox and install new worm gear spring
items.note: Free under recall 24V-744. Check your VIN. If the steering gearbox must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Brake booster check valve can stick (recall)
items.job: Clean or replace brake booster check valve
items.note: Free under recall 96V-106. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy properly (recall)
items.job: Repair passenger airbag module
items.note: Free under recall 97V-193. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Ignition switch can wear and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition switch (electrical portion)
items.note: Free under recall 02V-120. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver-side driveshaft can separate (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver-side driveshaft
items.note: Free under recall 12V-256. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel feed line seal may leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel feed line assembly
items.note: Free under recall 11V-288. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering column may not absorb crash forces (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace steering column
items.note: Free under recall 12V-548. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Piston pin clip may be missing on the 2.0L (recall)
items.job: Inspect pistons; replace pistons or engine parts as needed
items.note: Free under recall 16V-074. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electric parking brake may not set (recall)
items.job: Update brake control software
items.note: Free under recall 16V-725. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Right axle shaft may break (recall)
items.job: Replace right front halfshaft and align wheels
items.note: Free under recall 17V-706. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering assist can push the wrong way at full lock (recall)
items.job: Replace electric power steering gearbox
items.note: Free under recall 18V-663. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor can crack and set off the airbag (recall)
items.job: Replace front passenger seat weight sensor
items.note: Free under recall 26V-332. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake master cylinder can separate from the booster (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair brake booster and master cylinder mounting
items.note: Free under recall 23V-458. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering rack may let a front tire rub (recall)
items.job: Replace electric power steering rack
items.note: Free under recall 23V-704. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver seat frame may be loose (recall)
items.job: Replace driver seat cushion frame
items.note: Free under recall 24V-859. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Stability control unit may leak brake fluid (recall)
items.job: Replace VSA modulator and bleed brakes
items.note: Free under recall 23V-430. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump may crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace high-pressure fuel pump
items.note: Free under recall 24V-763. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture or underinflate (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag inflator
items.note: Free under recall 20V-026 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Accessory floor mat can hold the accelerator down (recall)
items.job: Replace driver floor mat and retention clip
items.note: Free under recall 99E-015 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat belt buckle can be hard to release (recall)
items.job: Replace rear seat belt buckle assemblies
items.note: Free under recall 01V-380 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Factory-mounted tire can lose air from a damaged bead (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace affected tire
items.note: Free under recall 14V-109 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering light comes on and the steering turns heavy
items.job: Replace electric power steering motor or control unit
items.note: Have the codes read first. Some cars need only the control unit, others the whole rack assembly.
